en-US.资料库只保存公开卡种信息，不含个人卡号、余额或积分。未知卡种仍可读取已确认的账户: The catalogue contains public product data, without personal card numbers, balances or points. Product recognition is separate from account reading.
en-US.有 {0} 个可能的卡种，无法确定: {0} possible card types; can't tell which
en-US.这个卡种暂时没有卡面图片。: No card image for this type yet.
en-US.只用来显示卡面和公开福利，不改变银行读到的卡名和金额。: Used only for the card image and public benefits. It does not change the name or amounts read from the bank.
en-US.未识别卡种，打开卡片可选择: Card type not recognised. Open the card to choose it.
en-US.无法保存福利标记，请先导出备份并检查浏览器存储。: Benefit storage is unavailable. Check browser storage and preserve a backup.
en-US.用完点一下；默认是待确认，不会替你猜已用或未用。: Tap when finished. Credits start unconfirmed; usage is never assumed.
en-US.{0} 项临近本期截止，仍待你确认: {0} credits are near their cycle end and still need confirmation
en-US.标记由你记录，可撤销；新周期重新确认。: Your marks are reversible. Each new cycle starts unconfirmed.
en-US.本期已处理，或没有可确定周期的 Credit: All handled, or no credits with a known cycle
en-US.这里是公开周期清单，不代表已登记或仍有余额。周年不明和版本未确认的福利在卡片详情: This is a public cycle checklist, not proof of enrollment or remaining balance. See card details for unknown anniversary dates and versions. The wallet shows alerts while open. While it's closed, turn on reminders in Settings or import this cycle's calendar reminders; add the calendar's later cycles separately.
en-US.没有匹配的福利，请调整筛选条件: No matching benefits. Try other filters.
en-US.由你自己的模型根据卡名推测，确认前不当作已识别。: Your own model guessed this from the card name. It isn't treated as recognised until you confirm it.
en-US.AI 暂时无法给出建议，请稍后再试。: AI couldn't give a suggestion right now. Try again later.
en-US.用 AI 推测卡种: Ask AI for the card type
en-US.会把银行、地区和卡名（不含尾号）发给你配置的模型。: Sends the bank, region and card name (without the last digits) to the model you set up.
en-US.AI 也无法确定这张卡的卡种。: AI couldn't tell this card's type either.
en-US.有 AI 建议的卡种，打开卡片确认: A card type is suggested. Open the card to confirm it.
en-US.不再提醒，可在「不再提醒的 Credit」里恢复: Reminders stopped. Restore it under “Credits you stopped”
en-US.不再提醒，可在 Credit 页面恢复: Reminders stopped. Restore it on the Credits page
en-US.这些 Credit 不会出现在钱包提醒、待处理和清单里；已经加进日历的提醒需要在: These credits stay out of wallet reminders, to-dos and lists; reminders already added to your calendar need to be deleted there. Restoring one brings it back as it was, with your earlier marks.
en-US.请填写有效的月份和日期；年份可以不填。: Enter a valid month and day; the year is optional.
en-US.已恢复为银行读取的值。: Restored the value read from the bank.
en-US.你的修改会保留，之后刷新银行也不会被覆盖；随时可以恢复银行显示的值。: Your changes are kept and a later bank refresh won't overwrite them. You can go back to the bank's values at any time.
en-US.名称不能超过 100 个字，也不能包含卡号。: Names can be up to 100 characters and must not contain a card number.
en-US.{0} 张卡需要设置年费日，才能显示按持卡周年计算的福利：{1}: {0} cards need an annual fee date before their anniversary credits can show: {1}
en-US.卡片信息已保存；换了地区，请重新选择卡种。: Card details saved. The region changed, so choose the card type again.
en-US.填年费日，周年福利才能算周期: Add the annual fee date so card-year credits get a cycle
en-US.当前持卡年度：{0} — {1}；周年福利、年费提醒和持卡成本都按它计算。: Current card year: {0} — {1}. Card-year credits, the annual fee reminder and cost tracking all follow it.
en-US.年费日取自你以前记录的持卡年度（最新一条）；那些记录用过不同的日期：{0}。请核: The annual fee date was taken from the card years you recorded before (the latest one); those records used different dates: {0}. Please check it.
en-US.每张卡只填这一个日期：周年福利、年费提醒和持卡成本都按它计算。银行页面不显示年费: This one date per card drives card-year credits, the annual fee reminder and cost tracking. Bank pages don't show it, so use your statement or the fee charge; leave it blank if you don't know.
en-US.在卡片详情的“年费日”一行点“去设置”。: Open the card and choose “Set” next to Annual fee date.
